facts.summary: A goodbye is a conversational message indicating that the user wants to end the current interaction.
response_purpose: Acknowledge that the conversation is ending.
facts.response_style: The response should be short, polite and natural.
important_notes: Do not provide unnecessary PDS information when the user is only saying goodbye.
Do not interpret a goodbye as a request for another PDS service.
Do not ask unnecessary follow-up questions.
